about_the_game:
Splash & Dash

Picture this: You're gripping the controller, paint splashing everywhere as you drift around corners at breakneck speed. Your buddy's screaming because you just launched them clean out of the arena. Another friend's pulling off some ridiculous aerial stunt that shouldn't even be possible. This is Splash&Dash, where friendship goes to die and legends are born. (Don't worry, we have a co-op mode)

Pick Your Vehicle

The Heavies don't mess around. Heavy, mean, and built to send opponents flying into the stratosphere. Subtlety? Never heard of it.

The Speedsters are all about that smooth life sliding through corners like butter, leaving trails in your wake. Pure finesse chaos.

The Standards, because every ice cream tastes good, including vanilla.

Every drift fills your paint tank. Every jump could be your last. Power-ups are scattered around like candy, and you'll want that paint bomb when your bestie's about to steal your lead.

Your Tournament, Your Rules

Want lightning-fast rounds that end in screaming matches? Done. Prefer marathon sessions that test true skill? Also done.

The deck-building system means no two games feel the same. Maybe you'll pull that perfect Tarot card after round one. Maybe you'll craft the ultimate deck from scratch and watch your friends weep. The choice is yours, and so is the sweet, sweet victory.

Unlock Everything (The Fun Way)

Trophies aren't just pretty, they unlock new characters, vehicles that shouldn't exist, Vehicle colours that hurt to look at, and cards that'll make you question (and break) the laws of physics. Every match matters. Every unlock changes the game.

Easy to Love, Hard to Master

Your grandma could pick this up in five minutes. Your friends will spend hours perfecting their technique. Whether you're screaming at each other on the couch or demolishing strangers online, Splash&Dash delivers exactly what you came for.

Why We Made This

We miss when games brought people together instead of driving them apart. We miss developers who listen. We miss art that pops off the screen and makes you smile. We are a team of 4 who have loved every moment of creating this game. And that's what Splash&Dash is really about: bringing back moments when gaming was pure joy, friendly trash talk, and the kind of fun that makes you forget what time it is.

  • OS: Windows 10

short_description: Paint-splattering combat racing where friendships go to die (don't worry, the afterlife is pretty cool!). Draft cards, claim territory, and betray your crew in chaotic 8-player couch warfare!
